name: a vector of per-process counters carried on every message
mechanism: each process keeps a vector with one counter per process, increments its own entry per event, attaches the vector to messages, and on receipt takes the elementwise maximum; one event precedes another exactly when its vector is elementwise no greater and somewhere smaller

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Vector clocks' in section Distributed systems algorithms: generate a partial ordering of events in a distributed system and detect causality violations

fails_when: vector size grows with the number of processes
